test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The difference between the interest payable on a sum invested for three years at 20% compound interest per annum compounded annually and 20% simple interest per annum for the same period is ₹448. What is the value of the sum invested?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective SI for 3 years at 20% = 20% × 3 = 60%

Effective CI for 3 years at 20% = 72.8%

Difference in effective rate = 72.8% − 60% = 12.8%

⇒ 12.8% of Principal = 448

⇒ Principal = (448 ÷ 12.8) × 100 = 3500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rate of interest (R) = 20% per annum

Time (T) = 3 years

Difference between CI and SI (D) = ₹448

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61c2ccb5b3bf874e0125bde5a93526e6b910da1b24c3431e062089cd5e71382b.png] 

**Formula Used:**

For 3 years, the difference between CI and SI is given by:

D = P × (R/100)² × (3 + R/100)

**Calculations:**

⇒ 448 = P × (20/100)² × (3 + 20/100)

⇒ 448 = P × (1/5)² × (15/5 + 1/5)

⇒ 448 = P × (1/25) × (16/5)

⇒ 448 = P × (16/125)

⇒ P = (448 × 125) ÷ 16

⇒ P = 28 × 125

⇒ P = 3500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years

For a 2-year period, the difference formula simplifies to D = P × (R/100)².

Effective Rate Method

For 3 years at rate R%, the effective CI is calculated as (3R + 3R²/100 + R³/10000)%.

Compound Interest Formula

The amount after T years is A = P × (1 + R/100)T, and Compound Interest = A − P.
